page_title: ARS 2-1 WOL | Arsenal v Wolves 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) duly receives a yellow card.

90+7' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Sam Johnstone allowed him to make a comfortable save.
90+6' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!

90+4' 2 - 1 Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the left post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90+3' 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' 1 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Matheus Mane is pounced on by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves). His close-range strike flashes past David Raya and into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
89' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
88' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Toti will be replaced by Matheus Mane (Wolves).
86' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
83' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
82' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
81' Substitution. Viktor Gyökeres makes his way off the pitch and Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
80' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Jhon Arias (Wolves) replaces Hee-Chan Hwang.
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Fernando Lopez (Wolves) coming on for Ladislav Krejci.
79' Fine play by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
78' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
77' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) produces a killer pass onto Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.

75' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
73' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
72' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
70' 1 - 0 Sam Johnstone (Wolves) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
70' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes straight for goal from the corner kick and is only denied by a good save from the keeper, who pushes the shot onto the crossbar.
69' Arsenal are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
69' Rob Edwards decides to make a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen will be replaced by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves).
69' Substitution. Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) in, Matt Doherty out.

68' Declan Rice (Arsenal) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Sam Johnstone made a crucial save!
67' A corner kick by Arsenal is thwarted by the well prepared Sam Johnstone (Wolves).
66' Declan Rice (Arsenal) unleashes a mid-range direct free kick, but sees his strike well saved by the goalkeeper. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Matt Doherty (Wolves) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
65' Matt Doherty (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Robert Jones signals. Arsenal earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
64' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
63' Matt Doherty (Wolves) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Declan Rice (Arsenal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Jones blows for a foul.

61' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
60' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
58' Martin Zubimendi goes off the pitch and Mikel Merino (Arsenal) comes on.
57' Here is a change. Gabriel Martinelli is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
57' Substitution. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) on for Eberechi Eze.

57' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
55' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Sam Johnstone is well positioned and punches the ball away.
54' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.
53' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

51' Sam Johnstone (Wolves) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
50' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
49' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
46' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Declan Rice (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball has crossed the sideline. Arsenal are taking a throw-in.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle as Matt Doherty (Wolves) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick to Arsenal.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' The ball is cleared after Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.
44' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is behind the touchline and Arsenal will take a throw-in.
41' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
40' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
37' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Bukayo Saka. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
37' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
34' The corner is flicked onto Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
33' Arsenal earn a corner.
33' Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Arsenal earn a corner.
31' Ben White (Arsenal) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Myles Lewis-Skelly.
30' Ben White (Arsenal) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
29' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.

27' Great solo effort by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the left side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.

26' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Arsenal.
23' Rough tackle by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves will take a free kick.
23' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) meets a cross inside the box, but Sam Johnstone wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
21' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
18' It looks like Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
17' Declan Rice (Arsenal) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom left corner is denied by a decent save from Sam Johnstone.
14' Looks like Joao Gomes (Wolves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
13' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Wolves.
12' A raking crossfield pass from Sam Johnstone (Wolves) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
10' The free kick is taken by Declan Rice (Arsenal), but ball is cleared.
9' It seemed like Declan Rice (Arsenal) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
8' Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

8' What an opportunity! Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
7' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take a corner kick.
6' Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Matt Doherty (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal are awarded the free kick.
5' Wolves show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
3' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
2' Matt Doherty (Wolves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Arsenal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Arsenal will kick-off.
Robert Jones will supervise the game today.
